name: The Village Pub
description: A rock-and-roll neighborhood bar on North Wellwood Avenue in Lindenhurst with a stage, pool, darts and bingo nights. Local cover and original bands play on Friday and Saturday nights.

dancing.notes: This is a bar with a band stage that holds roughly 125 people, not a dance hall. One bar directory lists dancing as something offered, and reviews praise the bands, but we found no photos or posts about a dance floor. Expect some freestyle dancing in front of the band on busy nights.

evidence.note: Music venue directory: live bands on Friday and Saturday nights, about 125 capacity, 21 and over; a reviewer mentions a good stage setup.
Bar directory lists dancing among the offerings, and reviews praise the bands; the bar does not have its own website.
Lindenhurst Chamber of Commerce listing with the address and live music, pool and dart leagues and bingo night.
